workflowDefinition.name: Argus Demo 2 Runner — Polymorphic Variant Swarm
workflowDefinition.description:
End-to-end demo runner for Scenario 2 of the Argus demo storyboard (soc-simulation/docs/argus/demo-storyboard.md):

  "The Mythos variant bank emits 30+ polymorphic variants of a
   single technique. Existing rules catch some, miss others. Argus
   labels the misses, synthesizes Pareto-efficient candidate rules,
   grades them with @kbn/evals-suite-argus-detection, and surfaces
   a per-axis gate verdict."

Like soc-demo-1-runner, this workflow does not perform the CPU-heavy work itself. The variant corpus is pre-seeded by setup.sh from the `soc-simulation/scripts/argus-variant-bank/` NDJSON bank. The eval sweep runs in the `@kbn/evals-suite-argus-detection` CLI. This runner:

  1. Verifies the variant bank for the demo technique is actually
     present (> 10 documents).
  2. Verifies that the latest eval run for that technique has landed
     in `.soc-detection-eval-runs`.
  3. Invokes the M2.2 reconciler so any rule promotions produced by
     the eval sweep get reflected on the advisory.
  4. Emits a per-axis summary to `.soc-audit-trail` so the dashboard
     can narrate P2 (variety) coverage in real time.

Preconditions on demo day:
  * soc-simulation/setup.sh has been run (or the variant bank is
    otherwise seeded).
  * `node x-pack/solutions/security/packages/kbn-evals-suite-argus-detection/scripts/run_detection_eval.js`
    has been run at least once since the last time the demo was reset.

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: Argus Demo 2 Runner — Polymorphic Variant Swarm
description: >
  End-to-end demo runner for Scenario 2 of the Argus demo storyboard
  (soc-simulation/docs/argus/demo-storyboard.md):

    "The Mythos variant bank emits 30+ polymorphic variants of a
     single technique. Existing rules catch some, miss others. Argus
     labels the misses, synthesizes Pareto-efficient candidate rules,
     grades them with @kbn/evals-suite-argus-detection, and surfaces
     a per-axis gate verdict."

  Like soc-demo-1-runner, this workflow does not perform the CPU-heavy
  work itself. The variant corpus is pre-seeded by setup.sh from the
  `soc-simulation/scripts/argus-variant-bank/` NDJSON bank. The eval
  sweep runs in the `@kbn/evals-suite-argus-detection` CLI. This runner:

    1. Verifies the variant bank for the demo technique is actually
       present (> 10 documents).
    2. Verifies that the latest eval run for that technique has landed
       in `.soc-detection-eval-runs`.
    3. Invokes the M2.2 reconciler so any rule promotions produced by
       the eval sweep get reflected on the advisory.
    4. Emits a per-axis summary to `.soc-audit-trail` so the dashboard
       can narrate P2 (variety) coverage in real time.

  Preconditions on demo day:
    * soc-simulation/setup.sh has been run (or the variant bank is
      otherwise seeded).
    * `node x-pack/solutions/security/packages/kbn-evals-suite-argus-detection/scripts/run_detection_eval.js`
      has been run at least once since the last time the demo was reset.

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: manual
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 1h

consts:
  corpus_index: ".soc-eval-corpus-argus-corpus-mythos-2026-04"
  primitive_id: "T1003.001"
  eval_runs_index: ".soc-detection-eval-runs"

steps:
  # ── 1. Precondition: variant bank populated for the demo primitive ──
  - name: count_variants_for_primitive
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
      size: 0
      track_total_hits: true
      query:
        bool:
          filter:
            - term: { "_argus.primitive_id": "{{ consts.primitive_id }}" }

  - name: corpus_gate
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.count_variants_for_primitive.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n >= 10 %}ok{% else %}undersized{% endif %}

  - name: log_corpus_missing
    type: console
    if: "steps.corpus_gate.output: undersized"
    with:
      message: >-
        Scenario-2 precondition unmet: expected >= 10 variants for primitive
        {{ consts.primitive_id }} in {{ consts.corpus_index }} but found
        {{ steps.count_variants_for_primitive.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}.
        Run `soc-simulation/setup.sh` to seed the variant bank.

  # ── 2. Precondition: eval sweep has landed at least one run ─────────
  - name: fetch_latest_eval_run
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.eval_runs_index }}"
      size: 1
      sort: "@timestamp:desc"

  - name: eval_run_gate
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        {%- assign _n = steps.fetch_latest_eval_run.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 -%}
        {% if _n > 0 %}ok{% else %}missing{% endif %}

  - name: log_eval_missing
    type: console
    if: "steps.eval_run_gate.output: missing"
    with:
      message: >-
        Scenario-2 precondition unmet: no rows in {{ consts.eval_runs_index }}.
        Run `node x-pack/solutions/security/packages/kbn-evals-suite-argus-detection/scripts/run_detection_eval.js`
        before triggering this runner.

  # ── 3. Kick the M2.2 reconciler so any rule promotions are reflected ─
  - name: run_exploit_to_detection_reconciler
    type: workflow.execute
    if: "steps.corpus_gate.output: ok"
    with:
      workflow-id: soc-argus-exploit-to-detection
      inputs: {}

  # ── 4. Bucket eval runs by gate decision for the demo read-out ──────
  - name: bucket_eval_runs_by_gate
    type: elasticsearch.search
    with:
      index: "{{ consts.eval_runs_index }}"
      size: 0
      query:
        range:
          "@timestamp":
            gte: "now-1h"
      aggs:
        by_gate:
          terms:
            field: gate_decision
            size: 10
        by_rule:
          terms:
            field: rule_id
            size: 20

  # ── 5. Heartbeat / demo-run marker ──────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_demo_run
        source: "soc-demo-2-runner"
        run_id: "argus-demo-2-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
        scenario: "2-polymorphic-variant-swarm"
        primitive_id: "{{ consts.primitive_id }}"
        corpus_state: "{{ steps.corpus_gate.output }}"
        variants_total: "{{ steps.count_variants_for_primitive.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }}"
        eval_state: "{{ steps.eval_run_gate.output }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: >-
        Argus demo-2 run_id=argus-demo-2-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }} variants={{ steps.count_variants_for_primitive.output.hits.total.value | default: 0 }} corpus={{ steps.corpus_gate.output }} eval={{ steps.eval_run_gate.output }}
